name: Holy Trinity Cathedral
subtitle: An Orthodox cathedral in Addis Ababa founded under Menelik II and completed in 1942.

facts.label: Burials
facts.value: Burial place of those who fought the Italian occupation

parts.text: An Orthodox cathedral in Addis Ababa founded under Menelik II and completed in 1942. Its compound is a burial place for those who fought the Italian occupation.
